ModuleName: Reading Standards Coverage and Checking Cognitive Depth

Artifacts.Name: Module Topics
Artifacts.Description: Lists and organises the topics and subtopics covered across the module, giving learners and instructors an overview of what will be taught and in what sequence.

Artifacts.Name: Introduction to the Standards Coverage View
Artifacts.Description: Introduces PreseMaker's Standards Coverage View, explaining what it is, why it exists, and how instructors use it to get an at-a-glance evaluation of how well their course addresses mapped learning standards.

Artifacts.Name: Understanding What the Coverage View Displays
Artifacts.Description: Explains the layout and components of the Coverage View dashboard — including standard rows, the Bloom's cognitive-level column, and the tiered status field — so instructors understand how to read the information it presents.

Artifacts.Name: The Tiered Status System
Artifacts.Description: Describes the four-tier status system (such as Not Aligned and Not Addressed) used in the Coverage View to indicate how deeply a course engages with each standard, helping instructors distinguish between standards that are ignored, acknowledged, practised, or formally assessed.

Artifacts.Name: The Cognitive-Depth Check
Artifacts.Description: Explains the Cognitive-Depth Check feature, covering what a cognitive-depth gap is and how instructors use the check to identify standards where aligned materials exist but student engagement falls below the cognitive level the standard actually demands.

Artifacts.Name: Strengthening Shallow or Incomplete Coverage
Artifacts.Description: Guides instructors through strategies for improving standards coverage that is shallow or incomplete, focusing on ensuring each standard is practised, assessed, and engaged at the appropriate cognitive depth.
